nodes.label: Rotating Hyperplane Benchmark (Arm B)

nodes.label: Frozen Model Cannot See Conditional Drift
nodes.norm_label: frozen model cannot see conditional drift
nodes.rationale: When P(y|X) moves but P(X) holds, any label-free statistic from a frozen model has nothing to respond to; refitting on a recent window measures the current concept but needs labels.

nodes.label: Permutation Negative Controls
nodes.rationale: A detector is only interesting if it stays quiet when drift is destroyed; refitted alarm moved from window 1 to 106.

nodes.rationale: Android + Firebase + ECLAT original; 2026 rebuild as React Native + FastAPI + DBSCAN with a human moderation step before any warning is published.

nodes.label: HTTP Request JSON Context
nodes.rationale: Request-level variants get a separate instructions file holding the request structure (and latest response) as JSON so scripts are tailored to it; the pre-request variant may read the response key only as context.

nodes.label: applyTo File-Pattern Scoping (pre/post x collection/folder/request)
nodes.rationale: Each instruction file targets a glob like '**/*-post-c-pm-*': pre/post picks the script phase and c/f/r picks collection, folder or request scope, so only the matching generator rules load.

nodes.label: Post-Response Test Script (pm.test + pm.expect)
nodes.rationale: pm.response is available after the request; assertions use Chai-style pm.expect; pm.response.json() must be parsed inside test callbacks, never held in a global. The bundled example contradicts this (global responseBodyJson, then references undefined responseJson) and keeps a // @ts-check line the note says to omit.

nodes.label: Pre-Request Script (setup only, no pm.response)
nodes.rationale: Runs before the request is sent, so the response object does not exist and tests belong in the post-response tab; used to set environment/collection variables, timestamps, UUIDs and headers.
